# stockportfolio.pro

> The AI analyst grounded in SEC filings. Research every US-listed stock with up to 19 years of filed financials, a free screener over the S&P 1500, free server-rendered fundamentals pages for 1,500+ companies, and an AI assistant that answers only from SEC filings — never from model memory. From $24.99/month; the screener and stock pages are free with no account.

stockportfolio.pro is a web-based equity research and portfolio tool for long-term retail investors. Every figure shown is computed from official SEC filings (10-K and 10-Q), refreshed nightly. Holdings are added manually, so no broker credentials are required. The product is owned and built by Avinash Sreekumar.

## Free, no account needed

- [Stock directory](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/stocks): fundamentals snapshots for 1,500+ US companies (S&P 500, MidCap 400, SmallCap 600) — revenue and earnings history, valuation, financial health checks, FAQ.
- [Any single stock](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/stocks/AAPL): replace AAPL with any ticker, e.g. /stocks/MSFT, /stocks/NVDA.
- [Free screener](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/screener): filter the S&P 1500 by growth, margins, ROE, valuation, and dividends — all from filed data.
- [Demo portfolio](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/demo): read-only sample portfolio, no signup.

## Paid product

- [Landing page](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/): product overview and pricing.
- [Research Dossier](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/dossier.html): the full report on any covered US-listed company — decision brief, filed trajectory, segments, valuation including a reverse-DCF, bull and bear case, risks. Same twelve sections for every company, every figure cited to its SEC filing.
- [Filing Change Monitor](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/monitor): when a new 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K lands, what changed against the previous filing of the same form — risk-factor edits, guidance language, the numbers that moved — quoted verbatim with EDGAR links, ranked by materiality.
- [Ask — follow-up questions](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/ask): ask anything about any US-listed company; every figure in the answer comes from SEC filings with sources shown. The follow-up to a report, not the main product.
- [Company workspace](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/company?symbol=AAPL): interactive view — up to 19 years of income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, 48 quarters, ratios, ownership, business segments from 10-Ks.
- [Register](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/register): pricing and signup.

## Pricing

- Free: screener, /stocks pages, and demo — no account.
- One meter: AI credits. A Research Dossier costs 10, a Filing Monitor report 5, a comparison 5, a follow-up question 2.
- Monthly: $24.99/month — full research library, portfolio tracker, 100 AI credits a month (10 Dossiers or 20 Filing Monitor reports, or 50 Ask questions).
- Annual: $199.99/year (two months free vs monthly), same 100 AI credits a month.
- Pro: $499.99/year — 600 AI credits a month, Dossier, Filing Diff, the Filing Change Monitor across your watchlist, wash-sale guard, smart alerts, weekly portfolio briefing.
- Desk: $1,999.99/year — 10,000 AI credits a month; Pro for one named professional with a limited client-facing licence, priority support, personal onboarding.
- Cancel anytime.

## Data licensing & API access (for AI companies and agent builders)

Crawling this site is denied in robots.txt and enforced server-side, because bot traffic was consuming most of a 5GB/month bandwidth allowance. Licensed access is the supported path, and it returns cleaner data than crawling the HTML would.

- [Licensing terms and tiers](https://www.stockportfolio.pro/licensing): what the corpus contains, what it excludes, and current pricing.
- Bulk corpus licence: SEC as-filed fundamentals (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow — up to 19 fiscal years and 48 quarters per company) plus a filing-change table (period-over-period deltas with a materiality score). Every row carries a `sourceUrl` to the original EDGAR filing. Delivered as CSV and JSON.
- Annual licence $5,000–$15,000/year depending on scope — company universe, history depth, and whether the filing-change table is included — with quarterly refreshes. One-off snapshot exports start at $500.
- MCP server: seven filing-grounded tools (financials, filing timeline, compare, screen, fund data, ask, health) behind an API key, with per-key rate limits and a monthly quota. Every response carries the filing it drew from.
- Not included: market data (price series, market caps, P/E — we don't hold redistribution rights), and no user or personal data of any kind.
- Contact: support@stockportfolio.pro

## Key features

- Up to 19 years of SEC-filed financial statements for every US-listed company (~10,400 searchable).
- Free stock screener over the S&P 1500.
- AI research assistant that answers only from filings, with sources shown for every figure.
- Business segments extracted from 10-K filings.
- Portfolio tracking, health checks, and SEC filing alerts.
